During FY 2025-26, HPCL declared an interim dividend of ₹5 per share, while the Board recommended a final dividend of ₹19.25 per share, taking the total dividend for the year to ₹24.25 per share.
Growth & demand: Supported by an extensive supply chain network, robust distribution infrastruc ture and a customer- centric approach, the Company achieved its highest-ever sales volume of 51.45 MMT, representing a 3.3% growth over the previous year.
